title: Create a tested text slug utility
request: Create a small Python utility that converts human-readable text into URL-safe ASCII slugs. Normalize accented Latin characters, lowercase text, replace runs of punctuation or whitespace with a single hyphen, and trim leading or trailing hyphens.
acceptance_criteria: Expose a public slugify(value: str) -> str function.
Convert accented Latin characters to their ASCII equivalents.
Collapse punctuation and whitespace runs into one hyphen.
Return an empty string for input with no ASCII alphanumeric characters.
